name: catalog-grids
goal: Present components and functions as responsive card grids while preserving revision links, evidence and responsive filtering.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Components and functions need neighboring card grids on desktop/tablet and one column on mobile. Component cards retain screenshots; function cards summarize contracts and link to recorded tests.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing catalog checks enforced a function table and only counted component cards. Extend the standardized catalog, navigation and responsive cases to assert both grids, contract summaries and revision-safe links.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Committed test revision 7143d0d2 fails the new standardized grid cases in all three viewports. Record ef9f0b8c seals the command and 1256 test/config inputs.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Opus 5.5 implemented responsive component and function grids using shared navigation, contract and verdict components. Sixteen focused unit tests, fourteen browser checks and Svelte checks pass.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
